bagPolicy.summary: For the Ariana Grande concert on May 3, 2019, Golden 1 Center requires all bags to be 100% clear and not exceed 12” x 6” x 12”. Cameras and recording devices are not permitted.
bagPolicy.note: Medically necessary items are permitted after inspection.

parking.note: Parking options around Golden 1 Center include various nearby lots and garages. Pricing may vary depending on the event and location, so it's advisable to check in advance. Arriving early can help secure a convenient spot.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in Golden 1 Center's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: Golden 1 Center offers diverse food options with a focus on local sourcing. Highlights include modern German bites, wood-fired pizza, and Mediterranean flavors, showcasing Sacramento's culinary scene.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: The Golden 1 Center is pleased to offer complimentary Assistive Listening Devices (ALDs) to guests with visual impairments & hearing difficulties.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: Golden 1 Center has a “no re-entry” policy during events. Guests who wish to return a prohibited item to their vehicle, or need to exit and re-enter due to personal emergencies, must first make contact with a Security Supervisor or Manager via Guest Services Stations to make necessary arrangements.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Will Call: Will Call tickets may be picked up on the day of an event or Kings game at the Golden 1 Center Box Office only. Will Call tickets may be picked up on the day of the event at the Box Office only.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: For Sacramento Kings games, doors open 1.5 hours prior to tip-off.
